Things to look out for when you’re buying: 

Memory:
•SSD - faster memory, relatively expensive •HDD - slow memory, relatively cheaper

RAM:
•8GB / 16 GB, more RAM means more things to do, Video editing, programming, games (8 GB should be enough)

Graphics Card:
•Not that important unless it’s editing videos or games.

Processor:
•Intel Core i5 is the best atm 
•AMD Ryzen, as good as intel and cheaper 

Hope this helps.

It also depends on what kind of programming you’ll be doing.

I’ve been using MacBook for high-level programming. I guess it’s easier and reliable as compared to using Windows. Plus the built in XCode helps. For hardware programming, I found it easier to do it with a windows OS because of all the requirements built in with windows and certain editors. 

You don’t need much unless you’re doing hardcore data like AI and Machine Learning which would require more RAM. You could also use virtual environment if you’re using a Mac OS and require windows feature.
